# CiCon Marketing

> CiCon Marketing is a boutique digital marketing and media production agency in Richmond Hill, Ontario, Canada. It builds local SEO, AI SEO, Google Ads and lead-generation systems for service businesses and dental clinics across the Greater Toronto Area (GTA). Founded in 2023 by Majid Behzad, a Google-certified strategist with 14+ years of marketing experience who runs every account personally.

Key facts:

- Name: CiCon Marketing
- Founded: 2023, Richmond Hill, Ontario
- Founder: Majid Behzad — Founder & Senior Digital Marketing Strategist. Master's in Engineering, Postgraduate Diploma in Marketing Management, Google-certified. Also a landscape photographer and digital content creator (@mbehzadpix on Instagram).
- Office: 30 Via Renzo Drive, Suite 259, Richmond Hill, ON L4S 0B8, Canada
- Phone: +1 (289) 807-1020
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/16475840800
- Email: info@cicon.ca
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9am – 6pm ET. Closed Sunday.
- Who we serve: local service businesses, home-improvement companies, trades, professional services and dental clinics in the GTA
- How we work: one senior strategist on every account, no junior account managers, no long-term contracts, monthly reporting tied to leads and booked appointments

## Services

- [All marketing services](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/): Overview of all services and starting prices
- [Dental marketing](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/dental-marketing-services/): Google Ads, local SEO and CDCP campaigns for GTA dental clinics, tracked to booked appointments
- [Dental SEO](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/dental-seo/): CDCP-aware SEO, Google Business Profile and local pack rankings for dental clinics
- [Paid advertising](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/paid-advertising-services/): Google Ads and Meta Ads management for GTA businesses
- [AI SEO](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/ai-seo/): Get cited in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity, with monthly citation tracking
- [Local SEO](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/local-seo-optimization/): Google Business Profile optimization, citations and review management
- [Social media marketing](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/social-media-marketing-services/): Platform strategy, content creation and paid amplification
- [Website development](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/website-development/): SEO-ready, conversion-focused websites for local businesses
- [Website development in Richmond Hill](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/website-development-richmond-hill/): Marketing-first web design for Richmond Hill and York Region businesses
- [Media and content production](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/media-content-production/): Brand photography, video production and written content
- [Content marketing](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/content-marketing/): Editorial strategy, blog writing and long-form content
- [Conversion rate optimization](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/conversion-rate-optimization/): A/B testing, UX and funnel fixes that turn existing traffic into leads
- [CRM integration](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/crm-integration/): Lead tracking from first click to booked appointment
- [Marketing technology setup](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/marketing-technology-setup/): GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels and CRM data integration
- [Marketing consultant](https://cicon.ca/marketing-services/marketing-consultant/): Strategic audit, marketing roadmap and KPI framework
